summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Production module (Daily Report, FGRN, Job Progress, SO integration). All core features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Login authentication (admin/admin123)
Backend: GET /production/report-options - returns operators, machines, processes, SOs
Backend: GET /production/reports/masterlist - filters by month, date, operator, SO
Backend: POST /production/reports - creates daily report with auto-save
Backend: PUT /production/reports/{id} - updates report
Backend: DELETE /production/reports/{id} - deletes report
Backend: GET /production/so-brief - returns SO list with customer, qty
Backend: GET /production/frn - lists FGRNs with filters
Backend: POST /production/frn - creates FGRN with auto-fill customer/description from SO
Backend: PUT /production/frn/{id} - updates FGRN
Backend: DELETE /production/frn/{id} - deletes FGRN
Backend: GET /production/job-progress - returns only prod_started=True SOs with aggregated qty_finished
Backend: PUT /production/job-progress/{so_id} - updates manual fields (due_date, plan_start, plan_finish, pic, remarks)
Backend: GET /production/new-so - returns SOs with prod_started status
Frontend: Production Portal shows 3 cards in correct order (Job Progress #1, FGRN #2, Daily Report #3)
Frontend: No separate 'Masterlist' card (correctly removed)
Frontend: Daily Report page has single view with 'Input Report' button and embedded masterlist
Frontend: Masterlist has filters (month, date, operator, SO) and Export Excel button
Frontend: Input Report modal opens with date selector and spreadsheet table
Frontend: Spreadsheet Enter key moves to NEXT COLUMN (right), correctly skipping read-only Customer column
Frontend: Customer column is read-only (tabIndex=-1, cursor-not-allowed)
Frontend: Customer auto-fills when SO number typed (verified with SO 005200 -> 'SPM, PT')
Frontend: Spreadsheet auto-saves on blur (operator field required)
Frontend: FGRN page has 'Buat Release Note' button and table
Frontend: FGRN modal opens with SO selector
Frontend: FGRN auto-fills customer and description from SO (005200 -> 'SPM, PT', 'BAUT')
Frontend: Job Progress page shows only started SOs
Frontend: Job Progress has inline editing for due_date, plan_start, plan_finish, pic, remarks with auto-save on blur
Frontend: Job Progress correctly aggregates qty_finished from FGRNs (tested: 0.5 qty -> 50%)
Frontend: SO Masuk page shows 'Mulai Kerja' and 'Batal Mulai' buttons
Frontend: Sales Order create form has Due Date field (data-testid='so-input-due')
Integration: Creating FGRN immediately updates Job Progress qty_finished and percent
Integration: Deleting FGRN immediately updates Job Progress (qty_finished decreases)
